description: This file defines a class ZipStream3 within the PhpSpreadsheet writer namespace that provides a static method to create a new ZipStream instance with specific options, used for handling zip file streams within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: ZipStream3
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to create configured instances of ZipStream.
